_doc: NAMED FINDINGS ONLY — never a count. A count cannot say WHICH finding was accepted,
so a new defect can enter as an old one leaves and the number never moves.
Every entry MUST carry a `reason` and an `owner`. The gate rejects a baseline that
omits either: an exemption without a reason cannot be reviewed, and an un-owned
NOTHING IS BASELINED BEFORE ADJUDICATION. This file is empty because all three
retention surfaces found by the audit were FIXED (commit e99f0ddd) rather than
accepted: MEMORY_CACHE, manifestTypeCache and PROOF_SHAPE_CACHE are all bounded.
An empty baseline is the correct state and should be kept that way.
The baseline is SHRINK-ONLY in spirit: when a baselined finding stops occurring the
gate says so, and the entry should be deleted in the same commit as the fix that
retired it. A baseline that outlives its fault goes vacuous and starts excusing
nothing while looking like it excuses something.
